freeze_boundary: All scientific thresholds, candidate order, scale=1 rule, and earliest-pass selection were frozen in the launch gate before training. This file only operationalizes token spans and the world exact metric. checkpoint-128 already existed, but no I-30 checkpoint had been loaded, scored, generated from, or otherwise evaluated before this mechanical freeze.

adapters.candidate_representation: exact parent-r96 plus checkpoint-r8 concatenation at residual scale 1.0, yielding one r104 adapter

teacher_forced_protocol.material_positions: all answer-body tokens after </think>, including EOS and excluding formatter-only trailing whitespace
teacher_forced_protocol.retention_positions: at most 128 uniformly spaced response-body tokens, always spanning first and final body positions

world_exact_protocol.answer_extraction: last standardized 正确答案是/最终答案是/correct answer is/answer is match; fallback final 选X
world_exact_protocol.metric: all gold option-letter tokens are top-1 under teacher forcing at the extracted final answer span

selection: Choose the earliest step passing both material directions, all seven retention tasks, and world exact. Then require itemic breakage 0/60 before packaging. If structure fails, test the next teacher-forced-pass step. Never search residual scale.
